description: Banho ao Bicho is a pet salon and self-service wash station situated in the Alvalade district of Lisbon. The team offers spa bath packages including shampooing, massage, blow-drying, brushing, hygienic trimming, and full clipping. Dead undercoat removal and deep conditioning treatments are also available. Appointments can be scheduled through WhatsApp or text message.
description_local: O Banho ao Bicho é um espaço de estética animal e serviço de lavagem situado na freguesia de Alvalade, em Lisboa. As marcações podem ser feitas por WhatsApp ou mensagem.
